subject: Re: Stipend for RFP benchmark - LumosAI
messages:
From: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@lumosai.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Stipend request for RFP benchmark

Hi Evelyn,

Hope you’re well — we’re running an RFP this quarter to evaluate inference platforms (goal: replace our current stack for generation and embeddings). Redwood is on the shortlist.

We typically ask vendors to provide a modest evaluation stipend so we can run a 2-week competitive benchmark (standardized prompts, representative dataset). Could Redwood provide a time-limited credit or stipend we can use for the bakeoff?

Quick details:
- Scope: 2-week window, up to ~200k tokens across gen + embeddings
- Participants: internal ML infra + procurement (cc’ed procurement handle below)
- Decision timeline: results due by Aug 1, award by Aug 10

Attached a short RFP summary so you can see the workload profile.

Would appreciate a confirmation of what you can offer and any basic T&Cs.

Thanks,
Jordan Liu
Senior ML Engineer, LumosAI
jordan.liu@lumosai.com

Attachment: Lumos_RFP_Summary.pdf
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@lumosai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stipend request for RFP benchmark

Jordan — thanks for the RFP + context and for considering Redwood. We can and want to support an apples-to-apples bakeoff. A couple quick items before I loop in approvals:

- Confirmed scope: 2 weeks, gen + embeddings, ~200k tokens (we have equivalent metrics to mirror your workload).
- Ask: do you require any specific model variants pinned for the test (e.g., 8-bit quantized vs fp16)?
- Logistics: procurement contact? we’ll need a PO/Procurement form for finance.

I’m looping in Jonas and Marissa to fast-track the stipend approval and procurement checklist. Tentatively we can offer a promotional stipend rather than open credits — that makes the billing path cleaner for procurement. I’ll propose an initial structure and get back quickly.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: —
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stipend request for RFP benchmark

Eve — thanks for flagging. Per our promotional guidelines and the comparable deals this quarter, approve the following conditional stipend:

- Offer: $3,000 promotional stipend (applies as platform credit, expires 45 days after activation)
- Equivalent: estimated to cover ~200k tokens at our standard hosted pricing; allows benchmarking across gen + embeddings
- Conditions: must sign a short stipend acknowledgement (covers usage limits and basic acceptable use); procurement form to be returned before activation; no transfer beyond the LumosAI account.

Please record deal_id RDW-2028-413 and include CS for post-bakeoff follow-up. Marissa — can you create the procurement form + DocuSign package and confirm the activation workflow?

Jonas
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stipend request for RFP benchmark — docs

Evelyn / Jonas — created the procurement package and the stipend agreement. Summary:

- Stipend document: RDW_Stipend_Terms.pdf (terms + expiration)
- Procurement form: Procurement_Form_Lumos.xlsx (PO fields + billing contact)
- DocuSign: DocuSign_RDW_Stipend_Agreement.pdf (link below)

Activation steps (two business days once completed):
1) Lumos returns signed procurement form + DocuSign acknowledgement.
2) Finance validates PO and logs the promotional credit against RDW-2028-413.
3) Credit is activated on LumosAI account and we send a usage window start date.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/rooms/abc123
Let me know if you want the stipend increased — we’ll need a short justification and Jonas’ sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: RDW_Stipend_Terms.pdf, Procurement_Form_Lumos.xlsx
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@lumosai.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, procure@lumosai.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jul 2028 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stipend for RFP benchmark - LumosAI

Jordan — great to chat through. Following internal approvals, Redwood is prepared to provide a $3,000 promotional stipend to support LumosAI’s RFP benchmark. Key details below:

- What you’ll get: $3,000 platform credit (applied to your LumosAI account)
- Validity: credit must be activated within 30 days of signing; credit expires 45 days after activation
- Usage window: we’ll propose a 14-day evaluation window once activated (you can request a different date in the activation form)
- Requirements: signed stipend agreement (DocuSign) + completed procurement form (Procurement_Form_Lumos.xlsx)

Next steps (please):
1) Team at Lumos: review and sign the DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/rooms/abc123
2) Return completed Procurement_Form_Lumos.xlsx to marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
3) Confirm pinned model variants if you want us to lock CPU/GPU settings for the test (optional)

If you approve, Marissa will activate the credit and share the activation timestamp. Stipend will be logged against Deal RDW-2028-413 for tracking.

Happy to hop on a quick 20-minute call if you want to walk through the scoring/metrics.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: DocuSign_RDW_Stipend_Agreement.pdf
